does: Cooks food in the steam of a little boiling liquid under a tight lid, so that nothing of it is washed away.

intro.what: Steaming uses vapour retained under a lid to cook food with little boiling liquid.
intro.why: It teaches you how a closed cooking space carries heat without immersing a basket of food.

how: Bring a shallow layer of water or wine to a boil in a wide pot.
Set the food in a basket above the liquid, or straight into the pot for shellfish, and cover it at once with a tight lid.
Keep the heat high and the lid on.
Sort mussels before they go in: throw away any with a broken shell, and any that stays open when it is tapped.
For mussels, shake the pot now and then, and take it off the heat as soon as the shells have opened. Throw away any mussel that stays shut.

cues.text: Vegetables are bright and just tender. Mussel shells gape wide open.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the lid again and again, which lets the steam out and slows everything down.
mistakes.fix: Leave it shut until the time is nearly up.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving mussels on the heat after they have opened, so that they shrink and turn rubbery.
mistakes.fix: Take the pot off the heat the moment most of the shells are open.

quiz.question: What carries heat to vegetables in a steaming basket?
choices: Only the dry metal of the lid.
Steam rising from the boiling liquid below.
quiz.because: The basket holds food above the liquid where rising vapour transfers heat.

quiz.question: Where should a vegetable basket sit?
choices: Above the boiling liquid beneath a tight lid.
Above an uncovered pot with most steam escaping.
quiz.because: Keeping food above the liquid preserves the steaming method while the lid retains vapour.

quiz.question: Which sound is consistent with active steaming in this covered-pot method?
choices: The scrape of dry food catching on the base.
The crackle of an uncovered frying pan.
quiz.because: Boiling liquid beneath the closed lid generates the steam used in this covered-pot method.

quiz.question: Frequent lid lifting slows the steaming. What should change?
choices: Lift it even more often to vent the pot.
Keep the lid closed between necessary checks.
quiz.because: Each opening releases steam and heat from the enclosed cooking space.
